description: PLATEAU's C02 building fixture read and written back with its nested city objects: every boundary surface, opening, building part, room, installation and piece of furniture keeps its gml:id and is written under the same parent and wrapper property as in the source, such as window W1 in wall WS1's bldg:opening and door D1 in interior wall IWS1's bldg:opening, with its geometry on itself rather than flattened onto the building. New-world only: the legacy writer flattens nested objects onto their feature.
